lead: Yes/No questions start with do, is, can, have or will. Tag questions end with 'isn't it?' or 'don't you?'. Both ask for confirmation. A response may begin with yes or no, or just give the facts.
Yes/No 問句以 do、is、can、have、will 開頭；附加問句結尾是 isn't it?、don't you? 之類。兩者都是要對方確認。回應可以用 yes 或 no 開頭，也可以直接講事實。
steps: Listen for the auxiliary at the start (do, is, can, have) or the tag at the end (isn't it, don't you).
聽開頭的助動詞（do、is、can、have）或結尾的附加問句（isn't it、don't you）。
Work out what is being asked: did it happen, is it true, will it happen.
弄清楚在問什麼：事情發生了嗎、是真的嗎、會發生嗎。
If a response starts with yes or no, check that the details that follow agree with it.
若回應以 yes 或 no 開頭，檢查後面的內容是否與它一致。
If there is no yes or no, ask whether the facts answer the question at the right time.
若沒有 yes 或 no，就看那些事實是否在對的時間點回答了問題。

head: Plain Yes/No questions
一般 Yes/No 問句
body: A response can begin with yes, no, or a short phrase such as 'not yet' or 'I think so'. A few words of detail often follow.
回應可以用 yes、no 開頭，或用 not yet、I think so 這類短語，後面常接幾個字的細節。
ex: Q: Did you receive the invoice? / A: Yes, it came this morning.
Q: 你收到發票了嗎？／A: 收到了，今天早上到的。
Q: Is the meeting still on Friday? / A: I think so.
Q: 會議還是在星期五嗎？／A: 我想是的。

head: Responses without yes or no
沒有 yes 或 no 的回應
body: A response can give a fact that implies yes or no. It must still match the time and the subject of the question.
回應可以給一個暗示 yes 或 no 的事實，但仍要符合問句的時間和主詞。
ex: Q: Have you booked the conference room? / A: I sent the request this morning.
Q: 你訂會議室了嗎？／A: 我今天早上已送出申請。
Q: Can you work on Saturday? / A: I'm out of town that weekend.
Q: 你星期六能上班嗎？／A: 那個週末我不在城裡。

head: Negative questions mean the same thing
否定問句的意思不變
body: 'Haven't they arrived?' asks the same as 'Have they arrived?', with a hint of surprise. Answer with the facts. 'No' means they have not arrived.
Haven't they arrived? 和 Have they arrived? 問的是同一件事，只是帶點驚訝。照事實回答，No 就是還沒到。
ex: Q: Isn't the bank open today? / A: No, it's closed for the holiday.
Q: 銀行今天不是有開嗎？／A: 沒有，假日休息。
Q: Didn't you get my message? / A: Yes, I replied this morning.
Q: 你沒收到我的訊息嗎？／A: 有，我今天早上回了。

head: Tag questions: answer the statement
附加問句：回答前面的陳述
body: A tag such as 'aren't you?' only asks the speaker to confirm. Ignore the tag, find the statement in front of it, and answer that.
aren't you? 這類附加問句只是請對方確認。忽略附加部分，找出前面的陳述來回答。
ex: Q: You're attending the seminar, aren't you? / A: Yes, I registered last week.
Q: 你會參加研討會，對吧？／A: 會，我上週報名了。
Q: The deadline is Friday, isn't it? / A: Actually, it was moved to Monday.
Q: 截止日是星期五，對不對？／A: 其實改到星期一了。

head: Yes or No must agree with the detail
Yes 或 No 要與後面內容一致
body: If a response starts with yes, the detail must be positive. If it starts with no, the detail must be negative. A mismatch makes the response wrong.
回應以 yes 開頭，後面要是肯定的內容；以 no 開頭，後面要是否定的內容。不一致就是錯的。
ex: Q: Did the client approve the design? / A: No, she asked for changes.
Q: 客戶核准設計了嗎？／A: 沒有，她要求修改。
Q: Has the shipment arrived? / A: Yes, it's at the loading dock.
Q: 貨到了嗎？／A: 到了，在裝卸區。

head: Same word, different meaning
同字不同義
body: A wrong response may use a word from the question in another sense, or a word that sounds alike. Choose by meaning, not by the repeated word.
錯誤回應可能用問句的字，但意思不同，或用發音相近的字。要看意思，不要看重複的字。
ex: Is the plant open on Saturday? Here plant means a factory, not something in a pot.
Is the plant open on Saturday? 這裡的 plant 是「工廠」，不是盆栽。
Will you book the hotel? Here book means reserve, not a thing to read.
Will you book the hotel? 這裡的 book 是「預訂」，不是書。

pairs.right: Q: Is the printer on the second floor working? / A: Yes, I used it a few minutes ago.
pairs.wrong: Q: Is the printer on the second floor working? / A: I prefer the second one.
why: The wrong response echoes 'second' but does not say whether the printer works.
錯誤回應重複 second，卻沒說印表機能不能用。

pairs.right: Q: You've signed the contract, haven't you? / A: Not yet, legal is still reviewing it.
pairs.wrong: Q: You've signed the contract, haven't you? / A: Yes, the sign is outside the office.
why: 'Sign' sounds like 'signed' but has a different meaning. It ignores the question.
sign 聽起來像 signed，意思卻不同，也沒回答問題。

pairs.right: Q: Did the client approve the design? / A: No, she asked for two changes.
pairs.wrong: Q: Did the client approve the design? / A: Yes, she didn't like it.
why: Yes and the detail disagree. If she did not like it, the answer is no.
Yes 與後面的內容矛盾。她不喜歡，答案就是 no。

pairs.right: Q: Haven't the samples arrived yet? / A: No, the courier is running late.
pairs.wrong: Q: Haven't the samples arrived yet? / A: Yes, I sampled the new menu.
why: The wrong response plays on 'sample' and says nothing about delivery.
錯誤回應只是拿 sample 做文章，沒有談到送達。

head: Typical question wordings
常見問法
items: Did you send the report to the client?
你把報告寄給客戶了嗎？
Have you met the new manager?
Is the meeting still on Thursday?
Can I use the projector this afternoon?
我下午可以用投影機嗎？
Hasn't the new catalog been printed yet?
You're joining the site visit, aren't you?
你會參加實地參訪，對吧？
The store opens at nine, doesn't it?
Do you have the latest price list?

traps: Echo words. A response repeats a word from the question (plant, book, order) but deals with something else. Ask whether it talks about the same event.
重複字。回應重複問句裡的字（plant、book、order），卻在談別的事。要問自己它是否在談同一件事。
Wrong tense. A question about tomorrow answered with 'It went well', or a question about now answered about last year. Check the time first.
時態不對。問明天的事卻回答「很順利」，或問現在卻答去年。先核對時間。
A negative question tempts you to flip the answer. Do not. Give the fact: if it has not happened, 'No' fits.
否定問句容易讓人把答案顛倒。不要。照事實回答：沒發生就是 No。
A yes or no that conflicts with its own detail, such as 'Yes, it hasn't arrived', is wrong. Listen to the first word and the words after it together.
yes 或 no 與自己後面的內容衝突，例如 Yes, it hasn't arrived，就是錯的。要把第一個字和後面的話一起聽。
